name: ecdfhist
expr: [n10, c10] = ecdfhist(f1, x1); [n5, c5] = ecdfhist(f1, x1, 5); [n3, c3] = ecdfhist(f1, x1, 3); [nU, cU] = ecdfhist(f2, x2);
comment: Sig: [n, c] = ecdfhist(f, x[, m]). Probability-density histogram from ecdf step data. Default m=10 bins. n is the per-bin density (sum of jumps falling in that bin / bin_width); c is the bin centre. Coverage: m ∈ {3, 5, 10} × uniform/non-uniform input.
